num_lower.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. 0-D tensor. Number of subdiagonals to keep. If negative, keep entire lower triangle.
constraints: num_lower must be one of int32, int64

num_upper.description: A `Tensor`. Must have the same type as `num_lower`. 0-D tensor. Number of superdiagonals to keep. If negative, keep entire upper triangle.
constraints: num_upper must have the same dtype as num_lower

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `input`.
